name: lvx_label_set_text

ownership.argument: borrows a live LVGL label and a NUL-terminated text string

provenance.source: exact 3.101.043 IDB stock callsites sub_C4C3804 and sub_C56D5B0

notes: Stock callers load a retained label into R0 and a text pointer into R1 before calling sub_C589490. The former corpus candidate sub_C588A70 is called with a packed color/property value and selector, not a text pointer.
